scope: iPad simulator full App process CPU, fixed daily closeup fixture, held direction ruler; no ball motion, no phone energy/GPU/frame-tail claim.
CPUWindow: marker +2 to +7 seconds; screenshot after +8; 12-second hold
diagnostics: work counts disabled; no reference flag; real pre-B1 checkpoint A vs final B1+B2 B
threshold: for each state, both paired reductions must exceed max(5%, abs(AA relative change)); no resampling
